$comment: The Spaarke package scope (T218c; ADR-027 §3 amended 2026-10-07). Rule: every unmanaged sprk_ component of the scoped types in spaarkedev1 (incl. every code page) + sprk_ columns, unmanaged views and forms on OOB tables + unmanaged dashboards + unmanaged field security profiles + roles of the ROOT business unit matching roleNamePattern or listed in roleNamesAlsoIncluded (a role authored in a child unit cannot be packaged; Secure Record Owner is created per environment by H7b, T256), MINUS the exclusions below. Every exclusion needs type, name (exact), reason and date. Read by scripts/solution-authoring/SpaarkePackageScope.psm1. Runbook: docs/procedures/SPAARKE-SOLUTION-RELEASE-PROCESS.md.
